machine.text: Gudanar da umarni a kwamfutarka, da shirye-shiryenta da sabobinta, kamar sabar haɓaka ta wani shafi. JavaScript da Python suna nan a keɓaɓɓen wuri.
machine.on: Ɗawainiyoyin da ke da fayil ɗin ajiya {folder} suna gudanar da umarninsu a wannan kwamfutar, ana tambaya kafin kowanne, har sai ka danna Ctrl+C a tashar umarninsa.
machine.question: A gudanar da wannan a kwamfutarka, a {folder}?
machine.app: Umarni na iya gudana a wannan kwamfutar ma, da shirye-shiryenta da sabobinta, a fayil ɗin ajiya da ka zaɓa: ɗawainiyoyin da ke da wannan fayil ɗin ajiya suna gudanar da umarninsu a can.
machine.failed: Bai fara ba: yana buƙatar Node.js a wannan kwamfutar, wato umarnin node a tashar umarni.
machine.on.app: Ɗawainiyoyin da ke da fayil ɗin ajiya {folder} suna gudanar da umarninsu a wannan kwamfutar, ana tambaya kafin kowanne.
machine.lede: Ɗawainiyoyi suna amfani da keɓaɓɓen wuri, sai dai waɗanda ke cikin fayil ɗin ajiyar da ka haɗa a wannan kwamfutar.
machine.step.open: Buɗe tashar umarni a ɗaya daga cikin fayilolin ajiyarka.
machine.step.paste: Liƙa wannan layin a can, sannan ka danna Enter.
machine.step.wait: Ana jiran layin ya gudana: wannan shafin zai lura da kansa.
machine.trusted: Yana gudana ba tare da tambaya ba a
